full_judgment:
The applicability of provision embodied in Rule 13 of Order IX of The Code of Civil Procedure (for short The Code) in the matter of setting aside of an order passed ex parte in a Pre-emption Proceeding under section 96 of The State Acquisition and Tenancy Act (thereafter called The Act) is legal debate which boils down in this Revision Petition laid under section 115 of The Code. 

 2. Factual canvas of case relevant for resolution of legal debate may be stated and noticed. 

 13. "Order" is defined in section 2(14) of The Code. Section 2(14) states that "order" means the formal expression of any decision of a Civil Court which is not a decree. Formal expression of any decision of a Civil Court is, thus, expressed by an order.
